episodes.175858: Deep-layer westerly flow occurring along a zonally oriented quasi-stationary frontal boundary yielded a multi-day atmospheric river event across Northwest California during late December. Widespread impacts due to heavy rain and strong winds were observed across the region.
episodes.176178: A gulf low develop along the Texas coast and moved northeast across the region. Heavy rain and severe storms occurred ahead of the low and associated cold front.

events.narrative: Several pine trees were damaged along with a few hardwoods. The tornado reached maximum intensity near County Road 4600 where a few pine trees were snapped within it's trunk. At this same location, a BBQ shack was heavily damaged along with an awning that was completely destroyed. A pontoon boat was ripped off of its trailer, and thrown approximately 25 yards into a pine tree. Two mobile homes also sustained minor damage along County Road 4600. Estimated maximum winds were 90 mph.

Rocks and debris across HWY 299 near Hawkins Bar due to heavy rainfall.
